tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Issue a monetary refund against a completed order. Returns the refund id and the amount credited. Do not use this to cancel an order that has not shipped yet — use cancel_order instead.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not yet shipped, releasing its reserved stock. Returns the cancellation id. Not for orders already delivered — use refund_order instead.
